scenes.title: Enough food, unfinished access
scenes.viewerPurpose: A society can have enough food and still leave people hungry.
scenes.composition: Food is visible at a source, but a family’s table is still empty.
addOrChange: Replace opening water cutaway with an accessible food distribution image, reusing the field/table motif from later scene.

cues.visualAction: Show the filled store and empty table together, with no implication that the family caused the gap.
Bring in the book title as a delivery route appears but has not reached the table.

scenes.title: What the planet can provide
scenes.viewerPurpose: The book examines what it takes to provide energy, water, food, housing, and essential care.
scenes.composition: A home receives useful services from visible built connections.
addOrChange: Remove meter and invented price indications; keep build, maintenance and access visible.

cues.visualAction: Introduce one household connection, then modest water and care symbols to widen the scope.
Show the installed collector and maintained line between sunlight and the home.

scenes.title: The things we cannot multiply
scenes.viewerPurpose: A house that exists is not much help to a person who cannot afford to live there.
scenes.composition: An available home is beside a person facing a cost they cannot meet.
addOrChange: Replace repeated electricity diagram with person, terms, calendar and location; do not assign fabricated prices.

cues.visualAction: Show the home complete while the person waits outside beside the access terms.
Shift to a limited calendar and desirable location, keeping these distinct from essential supply.

scenes.title: From possibility to a life
scenes.viewerPurpose: The book offers a hopeful question with practical difficulties still in view.
scenes.composition: A route brings food from the field to the household table.
addOrChange: Retain one meaningful movement and leave broader access as the question for reading.

cues.visualAction: Move one delivery partway along the route, making progress possible without claiming it is universal.
Hold the table, meal and route together beside the book.

checks: Do not generate voice until all122 script and visual plans pass review.
Use only source-grounded diagrams and neutral illustrative examples; preserve uncertainty and proposal labels.
Measure audio and keep the complete film at or below120 seconds without accelerating narration.
Inspect Color, Light and Dark at desktop and phone sizes; verify captions, labels and cue timing.
Listening review and visual QA are separate from having a compiled film.
